drivingQuestion: Why does the baraita need to state that work worth a sela is paid a sela?
outcomeNote: the employer need not add a dinar

segments.he: מַהוּ דְּתֵימָא אָמְרִי לֵיהּ: טְפֵי זוּזָא אֲמַרְתְּ לַן – טְפֵי זוּזָא הַב לַן, קָא מַשְׁמַע לַן דַּאֲמַר לְהוּ, כִּי אֲמַרִי לְכוּ טְפֵי זוּזָא: דְּלָא הֲוָה קִים לְכוּ, הַשְׁתָּא קִים לְכוּ.
segments.en: The Gemara elaborates: «Lest you say» that «they» can «say to him:» You «offered us a dinar above» the going rate, so now too, «give us one more dinar» than the current rate, to counter this, the baraita «teaches us that he» can «say to them: When I said to you» that I would add «one more dinar,» the reason was «that it was not clear with regard to you» that you would be willing to work for the lower wage, so I increased it. «Now it is clear with regard to you,» i.e., you agreed to a wage that was acceptable to you, and I do not intend to increase it further.

moves.summary: they might claim a dinar above the new rate
the extra was only because their willingness was unclear
